title: Requested image dimensions reach GPT Image
summary:
Image sizing and error messages got more useful, while Enter-routed requests shed redundant backend restrictions.

GPT Image requests now pass the requested width and height to Azure instead of always using automatic sizing. When Gemini returns no image, its response now gives a reason when one is available.

Enter now returns the actual error message instead of a generic “Oh snap,” making failed requests easier to understand.

Image and text backends dropped their own tier checks and model-specific caps for requests routed through Enter. GPT Image now honors requested high quality without a backend tier check. Enter’s own access rules and rate limits did not change.
